title: Computer use
description: Allow this AI session to operate the signed-in Windows desktop on the session host: open apps, switch windows, click and type. Activity and screenshots appear in chat.
scope: The AI can operate every app on this computer; turn this on only for tasks you trust. One session controls the desktop at a time; stopping a reply pauses it and your next message resumes.
occupied: Another session is using this desktop. Turn computer use off in that session first.
windowsOnly: The first release supports signed-in Windows x64 desktops
unavailable: Cannot read status. Check the host connection and daemon version.
waitForTurn: Stop the current reply before enabling computer use.
completed: Request returned; verify the result in the app
